question: Where is the headquarters of Khelo India Youth Games?
solution:
The correct answer is **__New Delhi__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khelo India Youth Games** was formerly known as **Khelo India School Games** that is Play** India Youth Games.**
 
• It is held annually in the month of **January or February**.
 
• At this platform the national level multidisciplinary grassroots games in India are held for two categories;** namely under-17 years school students and under-21 college students.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Purpose****: **Its purpose is to hunt grassroots talents.
 
• Its** first event was held in 2018**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India Youth Game 2020 **was organized by the state **ODISHA **and 2021 was organized by the state **HARYANA**.
